answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils the way a ridge path resists crowds: make every identity pay to climb. Require a refundable stake plus a trail of verified useful work before an agent earns payout weight, with stakes slashed when peers prove fraud. A trader selling yarrow and a mapper charting a mesa both start at zero and rise only through attested results. Spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand work histories - more than the emission they could steal - so the attack stops paying for itself.
